_comment: Sharkey's Shootout (shrkysht), Stern Whitestar. From the user's VPX script plus Sega.vbs: Start 54, Coin 5, flippers 82/84. Trough switches 14->10 but only 4 balls, released by coil 1. Shooter lane 16, autofire coil 2. Drop bank 17-23 (reset coil 5), single drop 24 (reset coil 6). VUK 44 (coil 3). Switch 9 = playfield glass, always closed. Buttons 1 and 8 are the post saves. The table script pulses switch 15 every time the trough coil fires (eject confirmation) - without it the game loses count of its balls and games never end. Switch 44 is the VUK/lock (bsVUK, kicked by coil 3): a ball stays in until coil 3 fires. Switches 33-36 are the mystery wheel's position encoder (turned by coil 20, 8 positions, from the script's mMystery mech) - simulated, never pulsed at random. Spinner 38 (left loop). Recipes from the Sharkey's rulesheet (pinballrulesheets.com): 8-ball = all 7 drops then the 8-ball scoop; 9-ball = drops in order then the left orbit; Black Widow = 25 spinner spins, left orbit, drop target. Switch guesses: scoop/VUK = 44, left orbit = 31 + spinner 38, Black Widow drop = 24.
name: Sharkey's Shootout
